import math
import factors


def factor_medium_momentum(bars):
    """60-day rate of change: medium-term trend direction, positive = still rising."""
    roc60 = factors.roc(bars, n=60)
    if math.isnan(roc60):
        return 0.0
    return roc60


def factor_short_momentum(bars):
    """20-day rate of change: short-term trend direction used to confirm breakdowns and reclaims."""
    roc20 = factors.roc(bars, n=20)
    if math.isnan(roc20):
        return 0.0
    return roc20


def decide(bars, account):
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 50:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for the 50-day trend filter"
    arr = factors.arr(bars, "close")
    sma50 = factors.sma(arr, 50)
    sma20 = factors.sma(arr, 20)
    if math.isnan(sma50) or math.isnan(sma20):
        return "HOLD", "moving averages not yet computable"
    price = closes[-1]
    above50 = price > sma50
    above20 = price > sma20
    golden = sma20 > sma50
    roc60 = factor_medium_momentum(bars)
    roc20 = factor_short_momentum(bars)
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if above50 or golden or roc60 > 0:
            return "BUY", "close above 50-day SMA, 20/50 golden cross, or positive 60-day momentum: staying invested in the uptrend"
        if above20 and roc20 > 0:
            return "BUY", "short-term reclaim: close above 20-day SMA with positive 20-day momentum, re-entering after pullback"
        return "HOLD", "below 50-day SMA and negative medium-term momentum, staying in cash"
    entry = account.get("entry_price")
    if entry is not None and entry > 0 and price < entry * 0.88:
        return "SELL", "hard stop: price fell 12% below entry"
    if not above50 and roc20 < 0 and roc60 < 0:
        return "SELL", "confirmed breakdown: close below 50-day SMA with negative short and medium momentum, de-risking"
    if not above20 and roc20 < 0 and roc60 < 0:
        return "SELL", "close below 20-day SMA with negative short and medium momentum: deeper breakdown, de-risking"
    return "HOLD", "holding: trend intact or only a shallow pullback"

import math
import factors


def factor_trend_gate(bars):
    """+1 when close is above its 50-day SMA, -1 otherwise; nan if too short."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 50:
        return float("nan")
    sma50 = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 50)
    if math.isnan(sma50):
        return float("nan")
    return 1.0 if closes[-1] > sma50 else -1.0


def factor_medium_momentum(bars):
    """60-day rate of change: medium-term trend direction, positive = still rising."""
    roc60 = factors.roc(bars, n=60)
    if math.isnan(roc60):
        return 0.0
    return roc60


def factor_reentry(bars):
    """+1 when short-term momentum has reclaimed (close above 20-day SMA and 5-day ROC > 0), else 0."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 21:
        return 0.0
    sma20 = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 20)
    if math.isnan(sma20):
        return 0.0
    roc5 = factors.roc(bars, n=5)
    if math.isnan(roc5):
        return 0.0
    return 1.0 if (closes[-1] > sma20 and roc5 > 0) else 0.0


def decide(bars, account):
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 50:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for the 50-day trend filter"
    sma50 = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 50)
    if math.isnan(sma50):
        return "HOLD", "50-day SMA not yet computable"
    price = closes[-1]
    above = price > sma50
    roc60 = factor_medium_momentum(bars)
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if above:
            return "BUY", "close above 50-day SMA: uptrend, entering"
        if factor_reentry(bars) > 0:
            return "BUY", "short-term momentum reclaim (20-day SMA + 5-day ROC): re-entering"
        return "HOLD", "below 50-day SMA and no momentum reclaim, staying in cash"
    entry = account.get("entry_price")
    if entry is not None and entry > 0 and price < entry * 0.88:
        return "SELL", "hard stop: price fell 12% below entry"
    if not above and roc60 < 0:
        return "SELL", "close below 50-day SMA and 60-day momentum negative: trend reversal, de-risking"
    return "HOLD", "holding: trend intact or only a shallow pullback with positive medium-term momentum"

import math
import factors


def factor_trend_gate(bars):
    """+1 when close is above its 50-day SMA (faster trend filter), -1 otherwise; nan if too short."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 50:
        return float("nan")
    sma50 = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 50)
    if math.isnan(sma50):
        return float("nan")
    return 1.0 if closes[-1] > sma50 else -1.0


def factor_reentry(bars):
    """+1 when short-term momentum has reclaimed (close above 20-day SMA and 5-day ROC > 0), else 0."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 21:
        return 0.0
    sma20 = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 20)
    if math.isnan(sma20):
        return 0.0
    roc5 = factors.roc(bars, n=5)

    if not above:

import math
import factors


def factor_trend_gate(bars):
    """+1 when close is above its 100-day SMA (slow trend filter), -1 otherwise; nan if too short."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 100:
        return float("nan")
    sma100 = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 100)
    if math.isnan(sma100):
        return float("nan")
    return 1.0 if closes[-1] > sma100 else -1.0


def factor_breakdown(bars):
    """+1 if close is more than 2% below its 100-day SMA (confirmed breakdown), else 0."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 100:
        return float("nan")
    sma100 = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 100)
    if math.isnan(sma100) or sma100 <= 0:
        return float("nan")
    return 1.0 if closes[-1] < sma100 * 0.98 else 0.0


def decide(bars, account):
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 100:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for the 100-day trend filter"
    sma100 = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 100)
    if math.isnan(sma100):
        return "HOLD", "100-day SMA not yet computable"
    price = closes[-1]
    above = price > sma100
    breakdown = factor_breakdown(bars)
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if above:
            return "BUY", "close above 100-day SMA: slow uptrend, entering"
        return "HOLD", "below 100-day SMA, staying in cash"
    entry = account.get("entry_price")
    if entry is not None and entry > 0 and price < entry * 0.92:
        return "SELL", "hard stop: price fell 8% below entry"
    if breakdown == 1.0:
        return "SELL", "close more than 2% below 100-day SMA: confirmed breakdown"
    return "HOLD", "above 100-day SMA, trend intact"

import math
import factors


def factor_ema_trend(bars):
    """+1 when close is above the 20-day EMA and the 20-day EMA is above the 50-day EMA (confirmed uptrend), -1 otherwise."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 50:
        return float("nan")
    ema20 = factors.ema(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 20)
    ema50 = factors.ema(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 50)
    if math.isnan(ema20) or math.isnan(ema50):
        return float("nan")
    if closes[-1] > ema20 and ema20 > ema50:
        return 1.0
    return -1.0


def factor_momentum_confirm(bars):
    """20-day rate of change: positive momentum confirms the trend is real, not a dead-cat bounce."""
    r = factors.roc(bars, n=20)
    if math.isnan(r):
        return float("nan")
    return r


def decide(bars, account):
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 50:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for the 50-day EMA filter"
    ema20 = factors.ema(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 20)
    ema50 = factors.ema(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 50)
    if math.isnan(ema20) or math.isnan(ema50):
        return "HOLD", "EMA not yet computable"
    price = closes[-1]
    uptrend = price > ema20 and ema20 > ema50
    downtrend = price < ema20 and ema20 < ema50
    mom = factor_momentum_confirm(bars)
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if uptrend and not math.isnan(mom) and mom > 0:
            return "BUY", "close above 20-day EMA, EMA20>EMA50, positive 20-day momentum: confirmed uptrend"
        return "HOLD", "no confirmed uptrend, staying in cash"
    if downtrend:
        return "SELL", "close below 20-day EMA and EMA20<EMA50: confirmed breakdown"
    return "HOLD", "uptrend intact"

import math
import factors


def factor_trend_state(bars):
    """+1 when close is above its 50-day average (and above 200-day if available), -1 otherwise; a simple trend regime flag."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 50:
        return float("nan")
    ma50 = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50.0
    above50 = closes[-1] > ma50
    if n >= 200:
        ma200 = sum(closes[-200:]) / 200.0
        return 1.0 if (above50 and closes[-1] > ma200) else -1.0
    return 1.0 if above50 else -1.0


def factor_momentum_confirm(bars):
    """20-day rate of change: positive momentum confirms the trend is real, not a dead-cat bounce."""
    r = factors.roc(bars, n=20)
    if math.isnan(r):
        return float("nan")
    return r


def decide(bars, account):
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 50:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for the 50-day trend filter"
    state = factor_trend_state(bars)
    price = closes[-1]
    ma50 = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50.0
    above50 = price > ma50
    above200 = True
    if len(closes) >= 200:
        ma200 = sum(closes[-200:]) / 200.0
        above200 = price > ma200
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if above50 and above200:
            return "BUY", "close above 50-day (and 200-day) average: uptrend regime"
        return "HOLD", "below trend averages, staying in cash"
    if not above50 or not above200:
        return "SELL", "close fell below 50-day or 200-day average: trend broken"
    return "HOLD", "uptrend intact"

import math
import factors


def factor_trend_gate(bars):
    """Close above its 100-day average and 50-day average rising: slow trend filter that avoids whipsaw."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 100:
        return float("nan")
    ma100 = sum(closes[-100:]) / 100.0
    ma50_now = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50.0
    ma50_prev = sum(closes[-55:-5]) / 50.0
    above = 1.0 if closes[-1] > ma100 else 0.0
    rising = 1.0 if ma50_now > ma50_prev else 0.0
    return above + rising


def factor_oversold(bars):
    """Short RSI(3) below 30 flags a sharp dip worth re-entering within an uptrend."""
    r = factors.rsi(bars, n=3)
    if math.isnan(r):
        return float("nan")
    return 1.0 if r < 30.0 else 0.0


def decide(bars, account):
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 100:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for the 100-day trend filter"
    gate = factor_trend_gate(bars)
    price = closes[-1]
    ma100 = sum(closes[-100:]) / 100.0
    ma50_now = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50.0
    ma50_prev = sum(closes[-55:-5]) / 50.0
    above = price > ma100
    rising = ma50_now > ma50_prev
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if above and rising:
            return "BUY", "close above 100-day average and 50-day average rising"
        if above and factor_oversold(bars) == 1.0:
            return "BUY", "oversold RSI(3) dip while above the 100-day average"
        return "HOLD", "trend gate not satisfied"
    if not above or not rising:
        return "SELL", "close below 100-day average or 50-day average turned down"
    return "HOLD", "uptrend intact"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Seed strategy: hold the stock while its close is above the 20-day average."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 20:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 20-day average"
    average = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    price = closes[-1]
    if account["position"] <= 0 and price > average:
        return "BUY", "close is above the 20-day average"
    if account["position"] > 0 and price < average:
        return "SELL", "close is below the 20-day average"
    return "HOLD", "no change"
